description: Action had 30+ properties (~400 bytes). Value type copies on every access/filter/Equatable check.
fix: Applied: Action now uses copy-on-write via ActionStorage class backing. Copying an Action struct copies only the 8-byte reference to the heap-allocated storage. Mutations trigger a deep copy via isKnownUniquelyReferenced. The public API (all properties, Codable, Equatable) is unchanged.
status: FIXED — COW-backed Action struct, ~400B → 8B per copy

area: KeyboardRemapEngine.swift: Event tap callback blocking on conditions
description: pixelConditionMet() called SCScreenshotManager.captureImage with DispatchSemaphore.wait() INSIDE the CGEvent tap callback. windowConditionMet() and token resolution also called AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue synchronously.
fix: Applied: pixel capture moved to background queue with async refresh + TTL cache. Window/AX properties cached with 1s TTL. Per-event condition result cache added. Cheap conditions are evaluated before expensive ones (short-circuit). NSEvent bridging cached once per handle() call.
status: FIXED — event tap no longer blocks on pixel/window conditions

area: RemapStore.swift: 1-second config polling with full JSON re-decode
description: startConfigPolling() used Timer.scheduledTimer every 1.0s calling Data(contentsOf:) + JSONDecoder().decode([Manipulator].self) even when file hadn't changed.
fix: Applied: replaced with DispatchSource.makeFileSystemObjectSource (kqueue) — fires only on actual file writes, zero CPU cost when idle.

description: saveConfig() and scheduleSaveConfig() both serialized and wrote to TWO files every time.
fix: Applied: only write to profile-specific file on each change. config.json mirror is written lazily — only on profile switch, app launch, or profile creation.
status: FIXED — single file write per change, config.json mirror only on profile transitions

description: RemapStore.executeAction() used MainActor.assumeIsolated {} to re-enter the action implementation from a global queue — undefined behavior.
fix: Applied: replaced MainActor.assumeIsolated with Task { @MainActor in ... } for proper actor switching.

area: KeyboardRemapEngine.swift: Redundant condition evaluation across routing passes
description: dispatchKeyDown() iterated routing.hotKeys, then routing.keyboard, then routing.stringTriggers separately. Additionally, TriggerGroup struct copied ManipulatorTrigger + [Condition], duplicating data.
fix: Applied: per-event condition result cache (eventConditionCache) avoids re-evaluating the same condition across routing passes. Conditions are evaluated in cost order (cheap→medium→expensive).
status: FIXED — conditions cached per event cycle

description: Manipulator is ~800-1200+ bytes. Every filter/sort, engine.apply(), RoutingCache.build(), and UndoSnapshot copied the entire struct.
fix: Applied: (1) RoutingCache now stores only UUID references + dictionary lookup instead of full Manipulator struct copies. (2) filteredManipulators debounced (150ms). (3) allTags/allFolders cached. (4) Action uses COW backing. (5) duplicateManipulator deep-copies actions explicitly.
status: FIXED — routing cache uses lightweight UUID references, Action uses COW, derived state cached

area: KeyboardRemapEngine.swift: Multiple Date() allocations per event
description: Date() was called at multiple points in the event tap hot path: resolvePress, advanceSimultaneousTrigger, handleMultiTap, advanceSequenceTrigger, executeFire, and sequence timeout checks.
fix: Applied: single eventTimestamp = Date() at the start of handle() is reused by all sub-methods. Reduced N Date() calls per event to 1.

area: KeyboardRemapEngine.swift: String-keyed Set for modifier tracking
description: heldModifierKeys was Set<String> with .insert/.remove on every flagsChanged event and .isDisjoint() checks for every key event.
fix: Applied: replaced with HeldModifierMask OptionSet (UInt16 bitmask). isDisjoint becomes a single AND operation. Also converted swallowedModifierKeys to the same bitmask.
status: FIXED — O(1) bitmask operations instead of string hashing

area: KeyboardRemapEngine.swift: Full routing cache rebuild on any change
description: apply() rebuilt entire RoutingCache from scratch on every config change, iterating all manipulators.
fix: Applied: diff-based routing update via RoutingCache.diffUpdate(). Only rebuilds routes for manipulators whose routing-relevant properties actually changed. Non-routing changes skip rebuild entirely.

description: NSEvent(cgEvent:) was created in handleFlagsChanged and checkStringTriggers separately.
fix: Applied: NSEvent is created once at the top of handle() and cached in cachedNSEvent.

area: KeyboardRemapEngine.swift: Pixel capture full pipeline for 1×1
description: SCScreenshotManager.captureImage for a single pixel went through full ScreenCaptureKit pipeline synchronously.
fix: Applied: pixel capture moved to background utility queue with TTL cache (0.5s). Event tap never waits for pixel capture.
status: FIXED — async background capture with cache

area: RemapStore.swift: allTags/allFolders recompute on every read
description: allTags and allFolders were computed properties that re-scanned the entire manipulators array on every access.
fix: Applied: changed to @Published cached properties rebuilt in rebuildTagFolderCache(), called automatically via applyRemaps().

area: RemapStore.swift: filteredManipulators on main thread without debounce
description: filteredManipulators ran filter+sort on main thread on every SwiftUI body evaluation or keystroke.
fix: Applied: 150ms debounce via Combine pipeline; sidebar uses debouncedFilteredManipulators.

description: postText truncated to 64 UTF-16 code units without warning.
fix: Applied: text is now chunked into 64-code-unit segments with sequential key-down/key-up pairs.
